podcast.title: Birth and Paternity
podcast.body: Born on January 27, 1989, her birth certificate initially named Pearl Lowe's husband as her father. Fifteen years later, blood tests confirmed Gavin Rossdale as her biological father following questions she raised about her paternity. "Little Daisy Low was born on January 27th, 1989. Her birth certificate listed Pearl's husband as the father. 15 years later, Little Daisy started asking some interesting and awkward questions about dad."

podcast.body: Daisy Lowe began modeling baby products at age two and started doing full photoshoots by age twelve. By fifteen, she signed with a major agency. "Mum had her modeling baby stuff at age 2. She began doing full shoots when she was 12. By 15, she was signed with a big agency."

podcast.title: High-Profile Modeling Work
podcast.body: Her modeling career includes appearances in Italian Vogue and Harper's Bazaar, and she has modeled for prominent brands such as Chanel, Vivienne Westwood, Burberry, Doc Martens, Converse, French Connection UK, and the lingerie line Agent Provocateur. "She's modeled for Chanel, Vivian Westwood, Burberry, Doc Martin's Converse, French Connection UK, and Agent Provocator, the lingerie line."

podcast.title: Media and Hosting Work
podcast.body: Beyond modeling, she hosted a TV series for the BBC, contributed to the online edition of Elle Magazine and other publications, and hosted events for Dolce & Gabbana and Tommy Hilfiger. "She's hosted a TV series for the BBC, wrote for the online edition of Elle Magazine, contributed to a bunch of other publications, and hosted events for Dolce and Gabbana and Tommy Hilfiger."
